mathematical_basis.final_incumbent_is_an_upper_bound: Complete exact separation returned an optimal nonpositive objective bound and certified the same incumbent robust feasible.
mathematical_basis.final_master_is_a_relaxation: It contains complete recourse blocks for an append-only subset of uncertainty scenarios, so its optimal solver bound is a lower bound for the full robust minimization problem.
mathematical_basis.historical_max_role: The historical max is retained only as trajectory/ledger evidence and is not used as the paper certification lower bound.
mathematical_basis.optimality_sandwich: The final master solver best bound equals the final master incumbent and UB; exact separation makes that incumbent feasible for the full robust problem.
